title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 595  An Act Converting the Lalawigan Municipal High School in the Municipality of Borongan, Eastern Samar, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Lalawigan National High School and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.
title.orig: Batas Pambansa Blg. 595  An Act Converting the Lalawigan Municipal High School in the Municipality of Borongan, Eastern Samar, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Lalawigan National High School and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Lalawigan Đô thị tại Thị trấn Borongan, Tỉnh Eastern Samar thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Lalawigan Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lalawigan เทศบาลในเทศบาล Borongan จังหวัด Eastern Samar เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lalawigan แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Lalawigan Kotamadya di Kotamadya Borongan, Provinsi Eastern Samar menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lalawigan Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Lalawigan Perbandaran di Perbandaran Borongan, Wilayah Eastern Samar kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lalawigan Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Lalawigan Municipal High School in Barangay Lalawigan, Borongan, Eastern Samar, is
hereby converted into a national high school to be known as the Lalawigan National High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
